description: Header file defining the gl::FramebufferAttachment class and related classes for managing framebuffer attachments in OpenGL ES context, including attachment types, resource management, and rendering targets.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachmentRenderTarget
classes.description: Implementation-specific object associated with a framebuffer attachment, non-copyable.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachment
classes.description: Represents a GL framebuffer attachment, supporting textures, renderbuffers, and surfaces.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachmentObject
classes.description: Base class for objects that framebuffer attachments may point to, such as textures or renderbuffers.

methods.name: FramebufferAttachment(const Context *, GLenum, GLenum, const ImageIndex &, FramebufferAttachmentObject *)
methods.description: Constructor with parameters to initialize attachment.

methods.name: detach(const Context *)
methods.description: Detaches the attachment from its resource.

methods.name: attach(const Context *, GLenum, GLenum, const ImageIndex &, FramebufferAttachmentObject *, GLsizei, GLuint, bool, GLsizei)
methods.description: Attaches a resource to the framebuffer attachment.

methods.name: getSize()
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment resource.

methods.name: getFormat()
methods.description: Returns the format of the attachment resource.

methods.name: getSamples()
methods.description: Returns the sample count of the attachment.

methods.name: isRenderable(const Context *)
methods.description: Checks if the attachment is renderable.

methods.name: initializeContents(const Context *)
methods.description: Initializes the contents of the attachment.
